G9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
TERMINAL branches only. Co-evolution acting on ancestral lineages is invisible here
and a FAIL leaves the internal-branch version untested rather than refuted.
Requiring exactly one human leaf discarded 38,317 of 54,308 trees, removing every
duplicated family -- and duplication is itself a co-evolutionary mechanism -- so
the retained set is biased toward single-copy conserved genes.
OmniPath and SIGNOR edges are literature-curated; G4 matches branch count, rate and
variance but cannot match how much a gene has been studied.
Nothing here tests Evo 2, whose nucleotide representation reads intra-genic,
promoter and non-coding covariation no gene-level branch rate can express.
